execution.patch_coordinates: nonoverlapping original-source UTF-8 byte offsets; validate expected bytes, then apply all edits together
execution.candidate_policy: the exact declared candidate must equal patch application; no dynamic candidate replacement
execution.empty_edits_policy: source==candidate is an explicit no-change control, not a rewrite proposal
execution.outcome_interpretation: engineering observations about supported source-aligned claims, never a semantic-equivalence or readability certificate
execution.local_operator_expectation_policy: null leaves the separate local outcome unspecified; preserve every per-predicate observation
execution.regression_policy: source and selected candidate match the prior manifest exactly; prior rule abstention remains separate from no-change guard outcome
execution.mismatch_policy: retain all mismatches, parser failures and unsupported cases without editing expectations after outcomes
execution.boundary_policy: desired preservation expectations are fixed independently of parser/guard abstention; only an exact prior rule patch can receive the guard's scope exception
execution.protected_expectations_policy: source/candidate anchors and declared review obligations remain alongside observed findings; do not turn them into human labels
